event.title: The name shown in the event list and event page. Use a name attendees can recognize.
event.date: Set the event date and time in Japan time. This time is the timetable starting point.
event.location: Enter the venue name or address so attendees can find the event.
event.venueUrl: Link to venue information or a map. Use an http/https URL.
event.description: Describe the event for attendees. Check the preview for the selected format.
event.descriptionFormat: Choose plain text, Markdown, or HTML for the description. Unsafe HTML is removed.
event.announcement: Enter an announcement to display to attendees on the event page.
event.headerImage: Choose a PNG/JPEG/WebP header image up to 10 MB. Large images are resized and compressed for display; originals are not stored.
event.capacity: Limit unique attendees including performers and spectators. Blank means unlimited. The limit cannot be below the current count.
event.color: Choose this event’s palette or inherit the site palette. Personal appearance preferences take priority.
event.mode: Choose inherited, device, light, or dark appearance for this event. Personal preferences take priority.
appearance.color: Choose the palette. Personal preferences apply only to your browser.
appearance.mode: Choose light mode, dark mode, or follow your device settings.
song.title: Enter the song title shown in the timetable. Voice/instrument combinations count as one song.
song.artist: Enter the artist name shown alongside the song title.
song.duration: Set performance length in m:ss or h:mm:ss, at least one second. It determines the performance end time.
song.prep: Preparation before this song, in m:ss or h:mm:ss. Use 0:00 for no preparation.
song.inheritPrep: Use the event’s default preparation time for this song. Turn off to specify a song-specific time.
song.parts: Choose the parts this song needs. Only parts defined in this event are available.
event.defaultPrep: Default preparation for songs without an individual value. The preset is ten minutes; enter m:ss or h:mm:ss.
event.plannedEnd: Optional planned end time. Saving warns on an overrun. An earlier clock time means the next day.
event.comment: Post a comment of at least three characters. Comment-only posting does not register parts or answers. Normally available until the end of the event day.
transition.title: Name a non-performance segment, such as a break or MC.
transition.duration: Length of this non-performance segment in m:ss or h:mm:ss. No preparation is added; zero is allowed.
part.name: Name shown for this part. Event definitions and site presets are managed separately.
part.category: Choose voice or instrument. This controls allowed combinations within a song.
phase.name: Name this stage of event registration.
phase.kind: Choose hidden, view-only, or custom. Custom stages accept registration and answer changes as configured.
phase.maxPicks: Songs per person in this phase: -1 unlimited, 0 no song registration. Spectators and event capacity are separate.
phase.activate: Japan-time start condition for automatic phase selection.
phase.deactivate: Japan-time end condition for automatic phase selection.
phase.evaluate: Reference time for testing automatic phase selection. It does not change the event date.
question.text: Write the question attendees or profile owners will answer. Custom answer fields do not receive fixed service help.
question.type: Choose a YES / NO or free-text answer.
question.required: Require an answer when submitting registration.
question.public: Publish counts and respondents to event viewers. Free-text content requires separate permission.
question.publicText: Publish free-text content in grouped charts. Only explicitly enabled questions are included.
profile.display: Your name shown on profiles and assigned parts.
profile.reading: How to pronounce your display name, to help other attendees.
profile.call: The name you would like people to use at the venue.
profile.socialService: Choose the social service shown on your profile.
profile.socialUrl: Your profile URL on the selected service. Use http/https.
account.email: Email used for login and identifying administrator candidates. Not shown on public profiles.
account.password: The demo password is demo. Do not enter a real password.
account.invitation: The registration code provided by your invitation.
invitation.code: Invitation code allowing a new account. Disabled codes cannot be used for new registration.
invitation.expires: The deadline for using this invitation to create an account.
admin.reason: Explain this administrator exception. It is audited with actor, target, and time.
admin.search: Find a scoped event administrator by display name or email and select a candidate.
admin.target: The person an administrator registers on behalf of. Event capacity still applies.
admin.exception: Administrator exception to normal voice/instrument combinations. A reason is required.
import.csv: CSV adding unregistered songs and segments without changing existing rows. Validate and preview first.
import.file: Choose a UTF-8 CSV. Download the sample and adjust Parts to the event definitions.
import.sheet: URL of a Google Spreadsheet available as public CSV. This mock cannot access authenticated sheets.
mock.conflict: Simulate a conflict on the first selected part to test partial success. Not production concurrency control.
